result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**\. However, the best choice depends on what platform your store uses, how much you sell, and whether you also sell in person.

If I were starting a small online store today, these would be my top choices.

## Top 5 payment processors

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Typical online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Excellent integrations and fraud protection
- Supports subscriptions and international payments

Best for: Independent online stores, WooCommerce, and custom websites.

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com/)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best for customer trust)

- Fees vary by checkout type; PayPal Checkout is typically 3.49% + \$0.49
- Recognizable and familiar to shoppers
- Offers PayPal and other payment options
- Easy to add to most online stores

Best for: Giving customers an additional trusted payment option.

[PayPal business](https://www.paypal.com/us/business)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Basic online card rate typically 2.9% + \$0.30
- Integrated directly into Shopify
- Simplifies order tracking and refunds
- No separate third-party processor required

Best for: Stores already running on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Online fees typically start around 3.3% + \$0.30 on its Free plan
- Excellent point-of-sale system
- Inventory and sales management
- Easy in-person and online integration

Best for: Businesses selling online and at markets, events, or physical locations.

[Square website](https://squareup.com/us/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing
- No standard monthly fee
- Volume-based pricing advantages
- Useful for growing businesses

Best for: Stores processing enough transactions to benefit from negotiated or interchange-plus pricing.

[Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com/)

Sources: [www.nerdwallet.com](https://www.nerdwallet.com/business/software/learn/stripe-vs-paypal-vs-square?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-online-payment-solutions-for-businesses-2026-buyers-guide/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/ca/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com) Rates are illustrative US pricing and can vary by plan and transaction type.

## My recommendation

For a small online store\:

- **Stripe\:** My first choice for most independent stores.
- **PayPal\:** Add it as another checkout option.
- **Shopify Payments\:** Choose this if you use Shopify.
- **Square\:** Choose this if you sell online and in person.

One important thing: Don't choose based on transaction fees alone. Payout speed, chargeback protection, fraud prevention, customer experience, and monthly costs matter too.

I have three questions\:

**1\. What platform is your online store using?**
